subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

Why __doesn't you try__ calling your family again?
solution:
The correct answer is **don't you try**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Both** don't **and **doesn't** are contractions and they both act as auxiliary verbs in a sentence.
 
• We use, **don't** in a sentence when speaking in the:
 
 
• first and second person **plural and singular**; and
 
• the **third person plural** ("I," "you," "we," and "they").
 
 
 
• In the above sentence the **third person plural **(you) is used hence, **don't **would be used instead of **doesn't**.
 
• Hence, the complete sentence would be, *Why **don't you try **calling your family again?__*

*Therefore, the correct answer is option 3).*
